request.approved_script: Six times seven. Here are six rows, with seven blocks in each. First method: split six into five plus one. Five rows give thirty-five. One more row gives seven. That makes forty-two. Second method: double three times seven. Twenty-one plus twenty-one is also forty-two. Same product, two ways to see it. Choose the method you can explain.

records.claim: Teacher verified integer distributive and doubling arithmetic and aggregate mastery.
